extension_role_policy: custom roles must use x- namespace with lowercase ascii token syntax

provenance.fingerprint: optional bounded opaque fingerprint; empty binds as null
provenance.runtime_subject: not duplicated here; derive subject binding from AgentWorkspace when present

workspaceBindInputPortMetadata.returns: true when metadata changed, false when identical

workspaceInputPortMetadata.returns: bound metadata or explicit unbound marker

composition.semantic_port: role/provenance remain independent of shape/layout binding
composition.runtime_subject: workspace runtime subject may coexist and remains the only subject authority
composition.introspection: describeWorkspace and describeGraph expose semantic port metadata when bound

invariants: semantic metadata does not allocate tensors
semantic metadata does not initialize or mutate LayerRegistry
semantic metadata does not alter AgentGraphBuilder topology
semantic metadata does not authorize execution
semantic metadata does not duplicate runtime subject authority
unbound semantic metadata preserves existing runtime behavior
custom roles remain possible through the x- extension namespace
